Create a modern futuristic SQL commands infographic poster for Instagram/social media. Show 10–15 useful SQL commands in a single clean layout. Dark cyberpunk theme with black and deep navy background, glowing orange neon accents, subtle grid lines, futuristic UI panels, modern developer aesthetic, bold white typography, mobile-readable design.

Layout style:

* Each SQL command inside compact glowing cards/panels
* Include command name + short one-line explanation
* Use terminal/code style fonts
* Add small database/SQL/dev icons
* Organized grid layout with proper spacing
* High contrast and ultra-sharp details
* Clean infographic style optimized for Instagram portrait post (4:5 ratio)

Commands to include:

* SELECT — retrieve data from tables
* INSERT — add new records
* UPDATE — modify existing records
* DELETE — remove records
* CREATE TABLE — create new tables
* DROP TABLE — delete tables permanently
* ALTER TABLE — modify table structure
* WHERE — filter records
* ORDER BY — sort query results
* GROUP BY — group rows with aggregation
* JOIN — combine data from multiple tables
* COUNT — count records
* DISTINCT — remove duplicate results
* LIMIT — restrict number of rows
* INDEX — improve query performance
